webhooks.detail: Dashboard-configured webhooks (POST/PUT) for Scraping Started, Completed, Failed events

evidence.quote: Webhooks let you automatically send HTTP requests to another API when specific events happen in your scraper — such as when a scrape starts, completes, or fails.

sandbox.detail: Free plan, no credit card required; token allotment (docs conflict: 100 vs 1,000 tokens/month). No separate sandbox.

evidence.quote: The Free plan includes **100 tokens per month** with no credit card required.

rate_limits.summary: Concurrency-based: 10 concurrent requests Free, 100 Pro; 429 with Retry-After. No per-second figure.

evidence.quote: The official [`@mrscraper/sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mrscraper/sdk) package is an async JavaScript and TypeScript client for the seven MrScraper services.
